answer:
**Project Lead（项目经理）与 Data Scientist（数据科学家）是 ML-enabled 系统项目中与需求关联比例最高的两个角色**，两者在统计上相互不可分辨，但都显著高于其余所有角色。

基于调查数据（276 名受访者，去除 82 名未作答 `-77` 后有效分母 n=194，Bootstrap B=10,000 次、固定种子 42、分位数 95% CI）：

- 各角色“表示关联”的比例：**Project Lead 约 51.0%（95% CI [43.8, 58.2]，99/194）**、**Data Scientist 约 49.0%（95% CI [41.8, 56.2]，95/194）**、Business Analyst 25.8%、Developer 19.1%、Solution Architect 12.4%、Requirement Engineer 10.3%、Others 9.8%、Tester 1.0%。
- **两类显著性结论（明确区分）**：
  1. 显著性成立（强）：“Project Lead 与 Data Scientist 同列前二、显著高于第三名 Business Analyst”——PL−BA 差 +25.3 pp（95% CI [16.0, 34.0]）、DS−BA 差 +23.2 pp（95% CI [13.4, 33.0]），Pr(前二均 > BA)=1.000（10,000 次抽样 100% 成立）。
  2. 显著性不成立：PL 与 DS 之间的次序——PL−DS 差 +2.1 pp（95% CI [−7.7, +11.3]，跨越 0），Pr(PL>DS)=0.644，Pr(DS>PL)=0.317，故二者为**统计上并列最高**，数据无法稳健地区分 PL 与 DS 谁更高。

题设给出的 49.6%/61.389%（及其极窄 CI）在本数据任何可辩护口径下均不可复现（各角色最大 `quoted` 计数仅 99，最接近的 124/202=61.39% 无法由数据构成；其 CI 宽度对应 n 达数万），判定其源自题设/原始论文的更大样本，仅作为同一对角色（Data Scientist 与 Project Lead）方向的旁证；最终结论完全以本数据口径为准。

payload.hypothesis: Project Lead (approx. 51.0%, 95% CI [43.8, 58.2]) and Data Scientist (approx. 49.0%, 95% CI [41.8, 56.2]) are the two roles with the highest proportion of association with requirements in ML-enabled systems; the two are statistically indistinguishable from each other (difference +2.1 pp, 95% CI [-7.7, +11.3]) but both are significantly higher than every other role, led by Business Analyst (approx. 25.8%), established with B=10,000 bootstrap resamples (Pr(top-two > 3rd) = 1.000).
payload.workflow: 1) Load 276x202 survey CSV; 2) treat -77 (and -99/-66 where present) as missing per domain background; Q8 '-77' maps exactly to 82/88 Suspended respondents with Duration=0 => excluded, leaving 194 valid Q8 respondents (incl. 6 Suspended who answered); 3) numerator = per-role 'quoted' count, denominator = 194 (uniform across all 8 roles since missing pattern is identical); 4) B=10,000 bootstrap with replacement (fixed seed 42), percentile 95% CIs per role; 5) difference distributions and Pr(.) for PL-DS, PL-BA, DS-BA; 6) significance: top-2 vs 3rd highly significant (Pr=1.0), PL vs DS not significant (CI crosses 0). Calibration values 49.6%/61.389% judged non-reproducible at n=194 (max quoted=99; nearest feasible fraction 124/202=61.39% impossible; their CIs imply n in tens of thousands), used only as a directional hint pointing to the same pair of roles; conclusions are strictly data-grounded.
